text: Implemented typed renderer-neutral raster images across shared grammar, device lowering, SVG, Canvas, and Java2D. Final verification: graphics 115/115 JVM + 115/115 JS; SVG 24/24 JVM + 21/21 JS; Canvas 6/6 JS; Java2D 7/7 JVM; dependent design 145/145 JVM + 145/145 JS. Independent oracles cover decoded PNG pixels, browser Canvas upload/rendering, Java2D pixels, alpha, orientation, clipping, interpolation, and z-order.
